**Finding submitted — WARRANTY: missing (fallback-level insert proposed).**

- **Investigated:** Article XIII in full (13.1 mutual reps, 13.2 RevMed reps "as of the Execution Date", 13.3 RevMed covenants, 13.4 mutual covenants, 13.5 disclaimer, 13.6 closing conditions), plus the Research (4.2(b) conduct standard), Manufacturing and Supply (7.1–7.3) and indemnity sections, and targeted searches for software, conformance, documentation and refund/repair remedies.
- **Conclusion:** No performance warranty runs to Sanofi. The 13.2 reps are IP/title reps frozen at the Execution Date; 13.3/13.4 are covenants (no debarment, compliance with Applicable Law, pharmacovigilance data); and 13.5 disclaims all other express and implied warranties. There is no conformance standard tied to a warranty period and no repair/replace/refund remedy anywhere — this fails even the fallback.
- **Cure:** One insertion (new Section 13.4A) at the fallback thresholds only — 90 days software-to-documentation, 30 days services, with repair/replacement/re-performance or refund. No edit to 13.5 was needed because it already excepts warranties "EXPRESSLY STATED IN THIS ARTICLE XIII"; I did not volunteer the preferred 12-month period, malicious-code or workmanlike elements.
